name: Puma Ultra 7 Play Velcro TT Jr

description.subtitle: Zapatillas de fútbol multitaco infantiles con velcro Puma TT suela turf - azules
description.tagline: Comfort and easy fit to enjoy football
description.intro: Las zapatillas de fútbol multitaco infantiles Puma Ultra 7 Play Velcro TT Jr están diseñadas para futbolistas que buscan ligereza, comodidad y un ajuste sencillo durante el juego. Su upper sintético ligero ayuda a mantener el pie sujeto, mientras que la lengüeta con cierre de velcro facilita la colocación y la suela de goma multitaco proporciona agarre sobre superficies de césped artificial corto y moqueta.
key_benefits: Easy and secure fit: The Velcro closure allows you to easily put on and take off the shoes, keeping your foot supported during play.
Comfort with every step: The lightweight construction and heel cushioning provide a comfortable ride during training and matches.
Lightness to move: The synthetic upper favors agile movements without adding unnecessary weight.
Stable Support: The upper construction helps keep your foot steady for confident play.
Grip on turf: The low-profile multi-stud outsole provides traction to move safely on short artificial grass and carpet.
